content: First design ID 1 simulated. Topology: balanced two-stage Miller opamp with S_mp3/S_mp1 = 6 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4. I_tail=71uA, I_2=228uA, Cc=0.8pF, Rc=3.5k (LHP zero cancellation of p2). Worst-case evaluation across 12 PVT corners shows Gain=512, Noise=14.4mV, SR=33.2V/us all PASS. Violations are in hot corners (100C): worst corner SS 1V 100C with PM=57.3 deg and UGBW=67 MHz. Handing over to diagnoser to adjust levers for UGBW and PM.

Design 1 is infeasible due to UGBW (-0.198, 67MHz) and PM (-0.023, 57.3 deg), both bound by worst corner SS 1V 100C where gm drops and p2 is at 38.5MHz. Operating point shows all devices healthy in saturation and perfect balance. Lever: reduce Cc to 0.5-0.6pF to raise gm1/(2pi Cc) above 160MHz and retune Rc to 4.5k-6.5k to cancel the 38.5MHz pole. Sizer should screen variants at SS 1V 100C and verify with corner_check before simulating.

Candidate ID 3 simulated and verified FEASIBLE across all 12 PVT corners! FoM = 0.4249. Specs: Gain=471.2, Noise=17.5mV, PM=60.44 deg, SR=36.96V/us, UGBW=101.9MHz, Area=5.58e-10, Current=512.6uA. Worst corners: PM at SS 1V 0C (60.4 deg), UGBW at SS 1V 100C (101.9 MHz). Zero failing corners. Sizer handing over to diagnoser for Phase 2 optimization.

Design 3 is fully FEASIBLE across all 12 PVT corners with FoM=0.4249. Binding constraints are PM (60.44 deg in SS 1V 0C) and UGBW (101.9 MHz in SS 1V 100C), both having tight margins (<1%). Gain (471) and SR (37 V/us) have ample margin. Hand sizing has reached all-corner feasibility; handover to rl-strategist for Phase 3 TD3 local refinement anchored on candidate 3 to explore multi-dimensional trade-offs for lower current and higher FoM.

Phase 3 RL refinement complete. Simulations used: 100 warmup + 100 training = 200 simulator calls (2400 corner runs). Best design remains ID 3 with robust FoM = 0.4249. Replay buffer contains 230 transitions. Two consecutive training batches (noise_sigma=0.1 and 0.05) explored locally around ID 3 without improving upon the expert hand-sized design, indicating candidate 3 is at an optimal robust operating point. Handing over to Phase 4 Polish.

Phase 3 RL round 2 complete: 200 training steps (300 RL steps total, 3600 corner runs). Candidate 3 remains the undisputed best robust design with FoM = 0.4249 and 100% all-corner feasibility. RL candidate 213 reached 59.96 deg PM and 110 MHz UGBW. Replay buffer now has 344 designs. Handing over to Reviewer.

Review completed for PVT-robust sizing run harness_20261107_142524. Final solution is candidate ID 3 with worst-case robust FoM = 0.4249, verified feasible across all 12 PVT corners. Detailed explanation written to harness_runs/harness_20261107_142524/explanation.md.
